summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of 7,519,351 common shares at $0.325 per share to institutional investors, along with a concurrent private placement of Series I warrants exercisable at $0.325 per share for five years post-stockholder approval. The offering is an at-the-market issuance via placement agent Ladenburg Thalmann, with no minimum offering requirement. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. The filing does not involve corporate control changes, strategic reviews, or restructuring.
